title: Saskatoon Berry Juice for Muscle Recovery
official: Effect of Short-term Saskatoon Berry Supplementation on Muscle Recovery
summary: This study will evaluated the effect of Saskatoon berry juice on recovery from muscle-damaging exercise.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female
* aged 18-35y

Exclusion Criteria:

* Conditions that might be affects by exercise as determined by the "Get Active Questionnaire"

sites.f: Physical Activity Complex, University of Saskatchewan
